BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.TECH   SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: PIE   SESSION: MO/2022

SUBJECT: PE206 METROLOGY & MEASUREMENT

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.

    CO BL
Q1 (a) Differentiate between material standard and wavelength standard. (2) CO1 BL1
Q1 (b) Describe the procedure for deriving Line Standard to End Standard. (3) CO1 BL2


Q2 (a) Define the term ‘Airy Point’, state the condition to achieve it. (2) CO1 BL2
Q2 (b) Draw the conventional Diagram of Limits and Fits and Explain the terms (i)
Basic Size (ii) Fundamental Deviation
(3) CO2 BL3


Q3 (a) Explain  the  ‘Hole  Basis’  and  ‘Shaft  Basis’  systems  of  fits  and  which  is
preferred and why?
(2) CO2 BL3
Q3 (b) Explain ‘Taylor’s Principle’ of Gauge Design. (3) CO2 BL2


Q4 (a) In a limit system the following limits are specified for a shaft and a hole:
     -0.005     +0.020
    shaft 30          mm diameter    Hole 30           mm diameter
     -0.018     -0.00
Determine (i) shaft and hole limits (ii) shaft and hole tolerance and (iii)
maximum and minimum clearance. (iv) Allowance (v) Type of Fit
(2.5) CO2 BL4
 (b) Explain  the  principle  and  working  of  the  ‘Johansson  Mikrokator’  with
suitable sketch.
(2.5) CO3 BL3


Q5 (a) Design  the  general  type  GO  and  NO  GO  gauge  for  components  having
20H7f8 fit. Given:
(i) i (microns)= 0.45 3D + 0.001 D
(ii) Upper deviation of shaft ‘f’ is = -5.5D
0.41

(iii) 20 mm falls in diameter step of 18mm to 30mm
(iv) IT 7 = 16i
(v) IT 8 = 25i
(vi) Wear allowance 10% of gauge tolerance & gauge tolerance is 10%
of work tolerance
(5) CO2 BL5
